compute_topk_accuracies: compute top-k accuracy percentages from model predictions and ground truth labels
compute_topk_errors: compute top-k error percentages from model predictions and ground truth labels
count_model_parameters: count the total number of parameters in a PyTorch model including scaled layers
count_model_flops: count the total floating point operations for a PyTorch model on cifar10 or imagenet
measure_model_ops_params: measure FLOPs and parameter counts by monkey-patching model forward passes with dummy input
